name: Lie Hao: Posui Jianxi
source:
Weiss, the new patrol officer, in the city of Warreton
Accidentally discovers a criminal deal
And is thus involved in a major conspiracy. In the process, two other personalities in his body also emerged. Trust? Desire? Or betrayal? It will start with this dark city a story far beyond your imagination.

The fates of many people are intertwined
And different actions lead to different results.

[From [url=https://mjlwan.itch.io/huntinghorn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
韦斯，沃雷顿市的新巡逻官
无意中发现一宗犯罪交易
并因此卷入了一场重大阴谋。在这个过程中，他体内另外两个人格也浮现出来。相信？欲望？还是背叛？它将从这座黑暗的城市开始一个远远超出你想象的故事。

很多人的命运是交织在一起的
并且不同的行动会导致不同的结果。

[来自[url=https://mjlwan.itch.io/huntinghorn]Itch.io[/url]]
